supplements.title: Campaign Generation
supplements.summary_text: DM guidance for campaign setup: adventure-hook archetypes, structure templates, tone guidelines. Consult when starting or pitching a new campaign.

supplements.title: Character Sheets & Creation
supplements.summary_text: PC creation workflow: race/class/background selection, ability score generation, the project's character-sheet schema. Consult during /add-player or level-ups.

supplements.title: Combat Rules
supplements.summary_text: Initiative tracker format, action economy, conditions reference. Always consult during combat or for combat rules questions.

supplements.title: Items, Loot, and Treasure
supplements.summary_text: Treasure-by-CR tables, magic-item rarity tiers, equipment basics. Consult when generating loot, awarding treasure, or pricing items.

supplements.title: NPC Generation & Roleplay
supplements.summary_text: Quick-NPC framework (HP/AC/attack by CR), personality generation tables (demeanor, motivation, secret, quirk). Consult during /add-npc or /generate-npc.

supplements.title: Spellcasting
supplements.summary_text: Spell-slot tables by class/level, concentration rules, ritual casting, common spell-rules edge cases. Consult for any spellcasting rules question.
